title: Richard Doty as Air Force counterintelligence

tellings.quote: you know Richard Dodie who was we now

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up a man named Richard Doty, whom he describes as having worked in US Air Force counterintelligence, the branch that guards secrets and feeds rivals false information. Michels mentions him alongside two other names from UFO circles, John Lear and Bill Cooper, suggesting Doty's role matters for understanding where some UFO stories came from.
